narrative_purpose: Renders Shannon's five-part communication system in Pandora's visual language so the reader can map the abstract model onto the bond: a source, an encoder, a channel under attack from noise, a decoder, and a destination — the skeleton every transfer in the chapter runs on.
subject: A clean left-to-right schematic on a dark page: a glowing source node on the far left, a short link into a small encoder block, then a long horizontal channel rendered as a luminous pipe or cable, with jagged spikes of dim chaotic static raining down into the middle of the pipe from above (the noise), then a decoder block, then a destination node on the far right glowing a different hue from the source.
scene: An abstract diagram floating in Pandoran dark space, each stage a softly glowing biological-tech form rather than a flat box.
camera: A flat head-on schematic view, evenly spaced stages along a single horizontal axis.
light: Each node and the channel pipe self-lit; the noise drawn as dimmer, colder, jagged intrusions disturbing the smooth channel light.
palette: Void-indigo ground, cyan channel and source/destination nodes, magenta accent on the noise to mark it as the antagonist.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate with a schematic clarity, hand-painted texture.
detail_level: Crisp on the five stages and the noise intrusion; background empty and dark.
composition: Single horizontal flow across the middle of the frame, generous dark space above and below for stage labels.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette; render the engineering schematic as living luminous forms, not flat office-diagram boxes. Noise is magenta and jagged. Keep open dark space for the five labels.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
